_comment: What the kit knows about the SQL preprocessor framework package, beyond
the pin. The pin itself - version, release, asset and SHA-256 - lives in
versions.json under components.preprocessor, like every other component:
sha256.release-sql pins the download, sha256.core-only the text the kit runs
(release.sql without its PYTHON3 scripts; `manage.py derive` computes it).
The laptop's record of what was installed is a different file:
dispatcher        the script that holds Exasol's one preprocessor slot
schemas, role     the objects release.sql creates, and the only ones the
kit may ever drop (recovering its own interrupted install)
required_scripts  checked after install and on every installer rerun
seed_scripts      the scripts release.sql's own CONFIG rows point at; a
rule naming anything else is someone's configuration
upgrades          tested in-place upgrade paths. release.sql is fresh-install
only: it re-creates the role and re-seeds rules. Until an
installed framework is verified and left at its version.
